texts.li: {B_nameDef} caught {A_nameDef} in the storeroom in the middle of the night, still chewing, with {A_possessive} pockets stuffed full. {A_nameDef} says {A_pronoun} was hungry. {B_nameDef} says it's the third time this week.\n\nWord was out by breakfast, and {B_nameDef} wants the council to deal with it.
Food has been going missing from the stores for days. Last night {B_nameDef} waited in the dark between the shelves and caught {A_nameDef} filling a sack.\n\n{A_nameDef} hasn't tried to deny it.

The stores have been running short all week, and this morning {B_nameDef} found a pile of picked bones and empty sacks under {A_nameDef}'s bed.\n\n{A_nameDef} says {A_pronoun} only took what {A_pronoun} needed. {B_nameDef} says the rest of the colony has been going to bed hungry because of it.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} off with a warning
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} got off with a warning. {B_nameDef} thinks the council has gone soft.

li.label: Make {A_nameDef} work it off
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is pulling extra shifts until the debt is paid. Most people think that's fair.

li.label: Punish {A_nameDef} publicly
li.outcome: The council punished {A_nameDef} at the evening meal, with the colony looking on. Anyone tempted by the stores will think twice now. The kinder colonists found it hard to watch.
li.riskOutcome: The council made an example of {A_nameDef}, who took it badly and went straight for {B_nameDef}.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} pried up a loose board in the old shed and found {COUNT} {THING} wrapped in oilcloth. Whoever hid it hasn't been back for it in years.\n\nSome colonists want it shared out tonight. Others would rather sell it, or see it destroyed.

{A_nameDef} was digging a trench when {A_possessive} shovel struck a buried crate. Inside were {COUNT} {THING}, still good, probably left by smugglers long before the colony came.\n\nWord got around fast.

li.label: Share it out tonight
li.outcome: The stash was shared out. Some people had a very good evening; the teetotalers went to bed early.

li.label: Lock it away for trading
li.outcome: The stash went into storage, forbidden, to be sold to the next trader. The ones who had hoped for a share are sulking.

li.label: Destroy it
li.outcome: The stash was destroyed. The teetotalers and ascetics approved. The colony's regular users took it hard.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have been at each other's throats for days. Today it was about whose turn it was to clean. Yesterday it was a borrowed knife that came back dull.\n\nBoth of them want the council to settle it, and both expect to win.

{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} had another shouting match, this time across the dinner table, and a spoon was thrown.\n\nThey've each come to the council separately, each with a list of complaints about the other.

This morning {B_nameDef} moved {A_nameDef}'s things out of the workshop. By lunch {A_nameDef} had salted {B_nameDef}'s stew until it couldn't be eaten. It has gone on like this for days.\n\nThe others are tired of it, and {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} each want the council to take their side.

li.label: Side with {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: The council sided with {A_nameDef}. {B_nameDef} walked out of the meeting and slammed the door.
li.riskOutcome: The council sided with {A_nameDef}. {B_nameDef} wouldn't accept it and went for {A_objective} on the way out.

li.label: Side with {B_nameDef}
li.outcome: The council sided with {B_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} took it badly.
li.riskOutcome: The council sided with {B_nameDef}, and {A_nameDef} answered with fists.

li.label: Make them work side by side
li.outcome: After a week of shared shifts, {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have made a grudging peace.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} lasted until lunch on the same shift before they came to blows.

li.label: Stay out of it
li.outcome: The council stayed out of it. {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} are left to stew.
li.riskOutcome: Left to themselves, {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} settled it with their fists.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} wants to cook a feast tonight with the best of everything in the stores. "We could all be dead next week," {A_pronoun} says.\n\nIt would use about {COUNT} raw food.

{A_nameDef} has been planning a seven-course menu for weeks and has finally brought it to the council. It would take about {COUNT} raw food from the stores, and {A_nameDef} has already worked out what goes into every course.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} cook the feast
li.outcome: The feast went on late into the night. People will be talking about it for weeks, and they'll expect another one before long.

li.label: Save the food
li.outcome: The food stays in the stores. {A_nameDef} has gone back to plain meals, and sets each bowl down harder than it needs to.

li.label: A smaller feast
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} made a good dinner from a modest share of the stores. It wasn't the banquet {A_pronoun} had planned, but people enjoyed it.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} came to the council after dark, ashamed, to admit something. The nightmares haven't stopped since the last raid, and {A_pronoun} has been skipping shifts to stay in bed with the door shut.\n\n{B_nameDef} has offered to help, if the council wants.

{A_nameDef} sat down in the middle of hauling stone this afternoon and wouldn't get up. Later {A_pronoun} told the council, "I can't keep doing this. I'm so tired."\n\n{B_nameDef} has been keeping an eye on {A_objective}.

li.label: Give {A_nameDef} a few easy days
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is taking a few easy days. Some of the harder workers are muttering about it.

li.label: Tell {A_nameDef} to get back to work
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} went back to work without a word.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} went back to work, but before the shift was over dropped {A_possessive} tools and wandered off, staring at nothing.

li.label: Ask {B_nameDef} to look after {A_objective}
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} has been sitting up with {A_nameDef} in the evenings. It seems to be helping both of them.
